en.headline: Police arrest 20-year-old over alleged HK$81,000 theft at Tuen Mun 7-Eleven
en.dek: The employer reported the money missing on Monday evening after checking the cash balance and reviewing transaction records that showed transfers to electronic wallets.
body: Police arrested a 20-year-old man on suspicion of theft after the person in charge of a 7-Eleven store at 43 Lung Mun Road in Tuen Mun reported more than HK$80,000 missing on Monday evening.

The employer checked the store’s cash balance around 10am and found about HK$81,000 missing. A review of transaction records showed several payments suspected of being privately transferred to top up Octopus, Alipay and WeChat Pay accounts. The employer suspected the employee, surnamed Lam, and called police at 6.57pm.

Officers arrested Lam on suspicion of theft and took him to Castle Peak Police Station. The Tuen Mun police district crime investigation team is following up. The whereabouts of the money and how the offence was carried out remain under investigation.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕20歲男子 涉屯門7-Eleven盜竊逾8萬元
zh.dek: 店主周一傍晚報案，指現金短少約8.1萬元，交易紀錄顯示有款項轉入電子錢包。
body: 警方周一傍晚接獲屯門龍門路43號一間7-Eleven負責人報案，指店內短少逾8萬元現金，隨後拘捕一名20歲男子，涉嫌盜竊。
店主約上午10時核對現金結餘時發現短少約8.1萬元。翻查交易紀錄後，發現多筆款項涉嫌被私下轉帳至八達通、支付寶及微信支付帳戶增值。店主懷疑姓林的20歲員工所為，於晚上6時57分報警。
警方以盜竊罪拘捕林，並將他帶返青山警署。屯門警區刑事調查隊跟進案件。款項下落及作案手法仍在調查中。
